messages:
marta: morning — cookie jar was full last night, now empty. who stole all the snickerdoodles? :sob:
james: had one around 11am? maybe midnight snack bandit. not sorry :sunglasses:
devon: I only touched the almond jar earlier, not the snickerdoodles. :seedling:
alex: saw a trail of crumbs from conference room to kitchen at ~2pm. someone is stealthy.
marta: posted pic: https://imgur.com/abcd123 (tiny crumbs on counter) — scroll for CSI
elaine: i didn't go near the kitchen after lunch, promise. brought donuts yesterday though. :doughnut:
james: @marta quick poll — should we restock or let karma handle it? :thinking_face:
marta: poll — react with :+1: restock, :-1: no, :shrug: open-source snack fund
devon: :+1:
elaine: :+1:
alex: :-1: (saving snack budget)
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen supply order goes out Fridays at 10:00. Place requests in #kitchen-supplies
marta: ok restock it is. any volunteer to replace with cookies AND a sticky note "do not touch before 4pm"?
james: i'll bring a box tomorrow. gluten-free option incoming.
devon: bless you. i'll add a tiny Post-it camera sketch: `•(~_~)•` — for deterrence.
elaine: hero of the hour. :tada:
marta: thanks team. also kudos to janet in ops for refilling coffee last week — legend :coffee:
alex: can we add "cookie police" to rotation? just kidding... kinda.
marta: thread closed — case of the missing cookies solved by democratic emoji.
